text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On our way home from a day out, we
overhear a loud voice coming from a
nearby arcade. We
decide to peek
inside...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, this piece of... It's freakin'
imposssssiiible!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. What's got you so worked up,
Jordan?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Take a look at this, Acute! Can you
believe this?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: What is it exactly? A punching machine?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If you can punch hard enough at

"Umamusume" level, you're supposed to
get a
prize...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But no matter how hard I wail on it, my
score still
sucks! It's gotta be broken!
No, I bet it's rigged!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Not gonna lie, I am high-key pissed! I really want to win that nail kit!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Poor dear. Sounds like you're in quite
the pickle.
Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Say, would you mind trying it one more
time so I
can watch?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean, sure. But stand back, because I'm going extra hard this round.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Taaake... THIS!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wham!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
See what I'm talking about?! There's no
way a hit
like that should get a low
score, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I think I get it...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Do you mind if I give you some pointers?
I think it
might help.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
First, don't make a fist with your thumb
inside. It
makes you adjust your punch to
protect your nail.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Next is your form. When you punch, you
want to
stand at an angle with the
opposite leg in front so
th—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: H-hold up! You mean like this?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Bend your knees a little... Now, lift up
your heel,
and keep your arms in tight.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Keep your wrist straight, pivot with your
lower
body, and...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Let it have it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: 'Kay, so... like this, this, and...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Let it have it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: WHAM!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Congratulations! You win a prize!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh?! F-for real?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
All I did was follow your instructions...
That's
crazy. My arm's trembling!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm legit gagged, Acute! Seriously, my
respect for
you just shot through the
roof!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Oh, pish posh. I just know a thing
or two
about boxing, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
They used to call me the "Straight-Right
Wonder"
back in the day.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
They used to call me the "Straight-Right
Wonder"
back in the day.
choice_data_list: Then if Acute hit it, would it be ...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
No problem. Since you already heard the
basics,
let's start with—
choice_data_list: Then if Acute hit it, would it be ...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, no fair! I wanna learn more too!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Let's wait our turn. We have all
the time in
the world, so there's no need
to rush.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, we set one new high score
after
another under Wonder Acute's
guidance.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I wonder... I suppose it's worth a shot...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hyuh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: BANG!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"An unexpected error has occurred.
Please inform
the nearest staff member."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, did I mess up? I must be a bit
rusty.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Damn, girl.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, I've come to know the true might
of the
"Straight-Right Wonder."
